# dokku_postgres_backup (Resource)

Manages the default scheduled S3 backup for an existing Dokku Postgres service. Requires a postgres plugin that reports backup schedules and authentication fingerprints.

## Requirements and ownership

1. Use Terraform or OpenTofu >= 1.11. Both credential arguments are native
   write-only values. Feed them from ephemeral variables or an ephemeral
   1Password item; an ordinary secrets data source can store its own result.
2. The Postgres plugin must report the schedule list and combined and individual
   authentication fingerprints. The live integration uses Postgres plugin
   commit `e5840e2ce85786b3ebedc06ac0c6d0b786732fb8` with dokku-datastore v0.12.0.
   Unsupported plugin reports cause an error before configuration changes.
3. This resource owns the service's default backup schedule and service-level
   backup authentication, including region, signature version, and endpoint.
   Use one resource per service. Existing authentication or schedules must be
   imported explicitly. Named schedules, multiple schedules, and IAM-backed
   schedules are rejected to avoid modifying shared settings.
4. Removing the resource unschedules its job and removes its owned authentication.
   It retains the database, bucket, and existing backup objects. Other manual
   backups using the same service-level credentials will need their own setup.
   Manage retention through the bucket lifecycle policy.

## Updates and credentials

Change `schedule` or `bucket` to update the existing job. Change `region`,
`signature_version`, or `endpoint_url` to reconfigure authentication in place.
After rotating keys in 1Password or another source, increment
`credentials_version`. Write-only values alone do not produce a Terraform diff.

Credentials are excluded from Terraform plans and state. The provider stores
fingerprints and recovery markers, and suppresses backup command/output logging.
Dokku must store the credentials on the host for unattended backups; its plugin
also receives them as process arguments, which privileged host users or tracing
may observe.

Schedules follow the server's cron timezone and require Dokku's docker-local
scheduler to generate the host crontab. External schedule changes are reconciled
on apply. External authentication changes require an explicit
`credentials_version` change before rotation and are not silently adopted.
Destroy refuses to remove a schedule or authentication that no longer matches
this resource's ownership records.

Failed reads preserve state, including permission failures. Remove this backup
resource before deleting its underlying service. If the service was deleted
outside Terraform, inspect the host before explicitly removing its stale state.
Failed schedule synchronization and owned partial credential writes retain
recovery information for a later apply or destroy. Unverifiable changes require
operator inspection rather than automatic cleanup.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires a provider build containing dokku_postgres_backup and
# Terraform/OpenTofu >= 1.11. Configure the Dokku and 1Password providers separately.
# The 1Password login item stores the access-key ID in username and secret in password.
ephemeral "onepassword_item" "r2_backup" {
  vault = var.onepassword_vault_id
  uuid  = var.r2_backup_item_id
}

resource "dokku_postgres_service" "app" {
  name = "app-db"
}

resource "dokku_postgres_backup" "app" {
  service_name = dokku_postgres_service.app.name

  bucket            = "database-backups"
  endpoint_url      = "https://${var.cloudflare_account_id}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com"
  region            = "auto"
  signature_version = "s3v4"
  schedule          = "0 3 * * *"

  access_key_id_wo     = ephemeral.onepassword_item.r2_backup.username
  secret_access_key_wo = ephemeral.onepassword_item.r2_backup.password
  credentials_version  = 1
}
```

## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access_key_id_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only S3 access key ID; not saved in Terraform state.
- `bucket` (String) S3 bucket name, optionally followed by a path prefix; omit the s3:// scheme.
- `schedule` (String) Cron schedule or descriptor, interpreted in the server's cron timezone.
- `secret_access_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only S3 secret access key; not saved in Terraform state.
- `service_name` (String) Name of the existing Dokku Postgres service.

### Optional

- `credentials_version` (Number) Increment to apply rotated write-only credentials.
- `endpoint_url` (String) Optional HTTP or HTTPS endpoint for S3-compatible storage.
- `region` (String) S3 region used for backup authentication.
- `signature_version` (String) S3 signature version used for backup authentication.

### Read-Only

- `auth_fingerprint` (String, Sensitive) Fingerprint of credentials last applied or imported by this resource for ownership checks.
- `auth_pending` (Boolean) Whether a credential operation may need recovery.
- `deauth_pending` (Boolean) Whether a credential removal may need recovery.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `owned_access_fingerprint` (String, Sensitive) Fingerprint of the last owned access key.
- `owned_bucket` (String) Last bucket applied or imported by this resource for ownership checks.
- `owned_schedule` (String) Last schedule applied or imported by this resource for ownership checks.
- `owned_secret_fingerprint` (String, Sensitive) Fingerprint of the last owned secret key.
- `pending_access_fingerprint` (String, Sensitive) Fingerprint of the access key in an incomplete operation.
- `pending_secret_fingerprint` (String, Sensitive) Fingerprint of the secret key in an incomplete operation.
- `schedule_sync_pending` (Boolean) Whether a failed schedule update requires retry.

## Import

Import the default scheduled backup by its Postgres service name. Provide both
write-only credentials in the configuration for future updates. Import reads the
existing configuration without reauthenticating or rescheduling it; set
`credentials_version = 1` initially, then increment it when rotating credentials.

```shell
# Import the existing default scheduled backup by Postgres service name.
terraform import dokku_postgres_backup.app app-db
```
